introHtml: Custom reusable straws with a carrying case keep your logo visible while offering a practical, eco-friendly alternative to single-use plastics. The included case protects the straw and makes it easy to carry in a purse, backpack, or lunch bag. Ideal for trade shows, employee gifts, or sustainability initiatives, these kits often include a cleaning brush and are available in materials like stainless steel or silicone. Options like the Collapsible Stainless Steel Straw Kit or the Buildable Harvest Straw Kit in Travel Case give recipients a complete, portable set they will use every day.
